dialogue_turns.text: [shouting with joy over the roaring crowd, rising] The wave! Here it comes! Wooo!
[to him, gently, a little sorry for him] It's gone.
[flat, unhurried, no apology] They were early.

payload.scene: A phone vlog in the top rows of a ballpark's upper deck on a bright afternoon, on a baseball weekend away; the whole crowd roars as the wave comes round the stadium. Luna stands and films herself cheering; Timo stays sitting beside her and only stands up once the wave has gone past.
payload.sample_context: A ten-second comedy short played by two close friends. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. LUNA, about 25, is loud with joy when the wave comes, then gentle and kind to him; she is never sarcastic. TIMO, about 30, is dry, proud and unhurried; he never raises his voice and never apologises: in his view the stadium got it wrong, not him.

text: The wave! Here it comes! Woooo! It's gone. They were early.
